description: Quote for placing a labeled, paid press release in the News by Hottub mix via Hottub Business. Price varies by topic tier, current topic interest, demand, targeting reach and duration; the response itemizes each factor. Country targeting also places it in that country's list on the news map (one paid slot, after the fourth story). Read-only: returns a price; books and charges nothing.
